restraint and prohibition. Let's see.

? Then what do you want taken off?

The only fortress of morality you have left.
This world's most baffling social etiquette.

………this silence is painful.

――And with that, let's undress! With all due

P-please try your best!

That damned #C236196003Rani#CDEF. And this was such a great

What's wrong, Darling!?
Be a #[man][woman]# and let it fly off, swoosh!
Come on, come on, come on!!!

It couldn't be that you aren't wearing any

Under these circumstances, I―――

That refreshing feeling of having
abandoned wastefulness―――
The Best Natural Condition.

…good.

pleased with it.

My ethos is the same as yours. Middle Eastern

I find it harder and harder to understand #C236196003Gilgamesh#CDEF.

Does he hate flattery, or is it his weak point?

Exactly as I planned. This is my scheme.
By no means do I have an #C000246204SG#CDEF or anything.
No, that's wrong.

Maybe #C236196003Rani#CDEF's True Self hasn't realized it,
or maybe she was hiding it. I don't know.

This girl appeared before me of her own accord.
#C236196003Rani#CDEF's cheeks are faintly flushed.
In other words―――
Your clothes scare, Rani.
Our clothes match, Rani.

What part is? I won't deny that the defensive
ability is rather low, but the degree of comfort
is heightened.

In real life,
I would claim that it balances out to zero.
…damn, I slipped up and used the wrong words.

It's true that they're a bit scary,
but that's not the topic at hand.

…my heartbeat has risen. I'm having difficulty
breathing. The same word is repeating in
my thoughts―――

Aah～ It's like my heart has become my brain.
I… am a no-good homunculus…
Why do I… feel so excited―――

Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF?

intentions and outward face were a mess… I was
rejecting, though I wanted to be understood.
